content:
As of the **2023 Formula 1 season**, **Max Verstappen** (Red Bull Racing) won his **third consecutive World Championship**, securing the title at the **Qatar Grand Prix** (October 8, 2023).

His team, **Red Bull Racing**, also clinched the **Constructors' Championship** for the **sixth time** in their history.

Would you like details on the 2024 season (which is currently ongoing)?
